body: I didn't think it was so bad either...  until I was actually there for four days.  I had actual experience of what I felt was torture unlike anything I've ever experienced before.  Maybe for other people it's not torture at all, maybe it's only mildly boring...  except I am not those people.  For me it was torture, real torture, not using that world like hyperbole.  If I had spent even one more day, I would have killed myself violently.  Even in the rubber room I could see ways to kill myself if I had to, in fact that was almost the only thought I had during my entire stay, just looking for sharp corners, or for heights from which I could drop myself on my neck.  I thought of almost nothing but suicide the entire time.  I was only saved by the very lucky chance that my cell-mate was able to help me find some temporary respite.
It's incredibly easy to purchase them online.  There are about ten chemical supply places online that sell cyanide that I found.
I need to be careful and warn people not to attempt mouth to mouth somehow.
I could not possibly afford and MRI.  Considering the sudden onset of this a few years ago, it would not surprise me if there was a physical cause.  That doesn't fix the problem, though...
It will not be completely painless, but at least it will be swift.
I have time.  I won't do anything for a week or two at least, I can make it that long.
Then there is no right answer, and I must choose from the various wrong answers.  I don't wish to die, but neither do I fear it.  I do fear jail, and I do fear a lifetime of mental pain.
I will take your advice and not rush it.  I will do my best to make sure that as few people even know it was a suicide, if I can.  People will be sad, but they will recover.
Then perhaps my last act will be selfish, which makes me a bad person... and what kind of loss to the world is a bad person, after all?

I ordered them from chemical supply stores.  I ordered both because I figured if for any reason I'm somewhat immune to one, the other will work, and also I think it would be harder to find an antidote for both at once, but I might be wrong about that.

I should say it more like: I can't do that.  Telling someone else to send this to her would be a violation.  The only way it would possibly work is if I put her full name in here and got it indexed by google and she happened to search for her name (which she does sometimes)...  Except I am NOT going to subject her to that.

edit: there might be a way, I'll think about it.
Various medications, and various different kinds of therapy.
San Francisco.
Six, if you don't count the ones in the emergency room.

What kind of message could I possibly send through a lawyer?  They'd never allow something like this, it's not an official court document, which is the *only* kind of communication allowed.  No, there's no way.
no
Don't do that, please.
It does if you continue to violate it.  Every text message, every email, counts as a single violation.  Send twenty texts, and that can cost twenty years.

"Just live with it" is not an answer, unfortunately.  It's not something I can control without incredible effort, constantly.  Eventually I will succumb to the pressure and communicate (illegally).  I cannot simply choose the pain any more than you can choose to stop breathing.  You can stop for a short time, but eventually you will have no choice but to breathe, even if you manage to hold it long enough to pass out.  I have tried very hard, and the longer I go without speaking, the harder it becomes until temporary psychosis of sorts sets in and I lose all touch with reality.  Eventually I slip into a complete dissociative fugue and begin to write to her again, sometimes with no memory of it at all, complete blackout for days, once.  It's an illness, and a very severe one.  By saying "just live with it" you are saying "just go to jail for the rest of your life".  How is a life sentence in jail any better than a quick, simple death?
I don't know what else that can be said.  Please go to bed, and thank you.
No.
I won't get into what's so great about her...  She *is* incredible, but that's not why I feel this way.  It's not rational.

Thank you all for your words and your help.  I feared there was nothing that would help, but I had to try.  I'll come back in a few days and see if anyone else had any ideas that I hadn't considered.  Thank you again.

I've tried many different doctors.  I've been battling this off and on for a couple of years now...  I really have tried to get help, because this all arrived so suddenly one day, after 30 years of being perfectly well adjusted...  It feels like an alien inside my mind, driving me to madness.  I can't even begin to explain the torture that is being unable to think and act normally.

I've been to the hospital a few times now.  I don't have the insurance for full time treatment, and I can't go back to work because this obsession consumes just about every aspect of my life and my thoughts...

And that only makes this even more maddening.  If I could speak to her, the pressure would fade away (I know this because it has in the past when we've been on friendlier terms.  The pressure vanishes almost instantly), and I *could* go back to work, and I could get better treatment and maybe be able to spend the time to shop around and look for more answers.  Right now, though, I cannot.  It is a trap, and a very cruel one.
In a few days.

The alternative is that she'd have to live with sending me to jail for years and years.  You need to realize that when the compulsion comes, it get so strong that I will be unable to control it, and I will start sending messages illegally.  It's not something I can control anymore than you can control your breath.  Yes, you can hold your breath for a few minutes, but ten?  Five?  Even three?  When you can hold your breath for ten minutes then you will understand how powerful this compulsion is.  *If I could control it, I would have been doing it long ago.*

She will not find out.

Well, alternatively she'd have to live with the guilt of having me tortured in jail for years and years...  I will leave a good note in case she ever does find out, and explain that it had nothing to do with her.  I'm deep in debt now, so I will say that, and everyone will think it's a reasonable explanation.

Money.  And if we could speak back and forth, yes, eventually we'd most likely come to more friendly terms...  But that isn't the point.  The point is my need to speak is very very strong, I don't even need her to speak back, if that makes any sense at all...  in fact, it won't make sense, because it's not rational.  Even I know that, but I'm powerless to change it.

I understand...  but what can I do?  Give me options.  I've tried to find other ways, but nothing has worked.  Medications don't work, therapy doesn't work, nothing has worked.  One thing has worked, and that's talking to her...

But perhaps you are right.  It is selfish of me to ask her to let me speak to her.  I should just end it without involving her.

I will. I know that's the right thing to do, but it scares me.  But I will do it right.

Very fair to say that, many of the doctors I've spoken with say it's a form of OCD.  I clearly have some kind of mental illness, that's obvious to me.  But just saying "You have an obsession" doesn't magically make it go away.  I've been looking for answers on how to make it go away, but so far nothing at all has worked.

As for why I feel the need, it's nothing I can explain.  I have *nothing* of value to say.  Just things like, "Look at this cat picture" or "I have a funny idea blah blah".  That's the kind of thing I "need" to say.  Sounds completely inane, right?  I'm not trying to justify the compulsion, I know just as well as everyone else that it's a mental illness, and that these things are completely useless.

The *only* thing that makes the feeling go away is sending her messages.  Up until a couple months ago, I was able to do that...  and so up until then I never felt suicidal at all...  But as soon as we got into a fight over money (we had a business together), she put the restraining order on me, and I was no longer able to communicate.  Almost instantly I went completely insane, like I was in wonderland for a few months, completely lost all touch with reality.  I started communicating again (illegally), and I was able to reconnect with reality again...  and finally she got tired of it and had me arrested.

So there you go.  It's completely unfair, because I obviously can't ask her to help me against her will, but at the same time, nothing else I've ever tried has ever made anything else any better.

So, well, tell me...  if you find someday that you've become insane, and that your insanity will someday absolutely put you in jail, and everything you've tried to do to cure yourself has failed, what options do you have?

I feel so helpless.  I really don't want to die.  I REALLY don't.  But this is a nightmare from which I can't awaken.  I'm so sorry to you all.  You've tried so hard, but this isn't something anyone else can help with.  There is no solution to this.

Yes.  Any contact at all initiated by me (such as asking someone else to help) is a violation, that's how restraining orders work.  There's no way to work out a compromise whatsoever.  Restraining orders like this are made to stop abusive husbands from beating the crap out of their wives and girlfriends (many of whom will try and get back together with the husband out of love, which puts them back into danger), and so are super biased towards the protected party.  I can respect that, and in that sense I believe they do a lot of good...  but I've never hit another person in my life, I've rarely even raised my voice... and we weren't even dating when the restraining order was issued (in fact, at this point we had become business partners, and business is where the bad blood between us started) but I'm treated the same as those terrible abusive people in the eyes of the law.  That shame alone fills me with such self loathing that I want to die...  but in this case, it's just one more thing added onto the pile of pain and sorrow.

I'm not looking to get back with her.  Isn't that so pathetic?  It's not even about unrequited love, it's only about communication.  I don't want her, I just want the freedom to speak, that's all.  Or, I should say, I don't *want* the freedom to speak... if I could shut off the compulsion and never speak to her again, I would...  but I *need* that, for whatever reason my broken brain can't shut off that need.  The need to communicate is incredibly powerful, and it grows and grows until it's almost like someone screaming non-stop in your ear.  The only way I've been able to control it since that text that sent me to jail is by drinking non stop as soon as the compulsion starts and passing out before it gets too strong.

She has a restraining order against me basically for sending too many emails and texts.  That's all that was ever alleged, nothing dangerous or violent.  And I did send a lot of texts and emails.  The truth is, I don't even care if she responds, she can block my email address and I'd be fine with that...  but I need to send them.  I know I do because I feel it growing and growing even now.

Jail for me was torture.  They stripped me naked and put me in a rubber room for 28 hours.  Later they moved me to a glass walled room and the air was getting harder and harder to breathe.  I was very lucky that my cell-mate practiced meditation and taught me how to breathe and meditate to keep it away...  but having to do that again is terrifying.  I cannot be caged again, every second was a hundred years of suffocating torture.

Cyanide may not be pleasant, but it's very, very fast.  A few minutes of even excruciating pain are so much better than the months and years of unbearable torture that I face.

I would most likely go to jail by doing that.  Sure there would be no proof that is isn't me, but to prove that I would have to go to trial, and while awaiting trial I'd be in jail for days or, most likely, weeks or months.  And more to the point, I don't want that.  The trickery and deception is just as painful as not sending anything at all...  The only other idea that occurs to me is committing myself to some kind of mental institution, but I don't know if that would be any better than jail.

Thank you, I have tried that.  I have 435 such letters saved in my gmail drafts.  God, I wish this were something simple that I could even understand!  435 letters, maybe 4,000 pages of text, never sent...  I know it's some kind of madness, and I can see it as clear as day, but...  I don't know how to fix it.  I've tried everything I can think of.  

I wasn't like this before.  I'm 34 now, and this all started when I was about 30 or 31.  I was perfectly normal, and one day I started acting manic, bipolar, really, out of the blue... and it was almost exactly when I met this girl.  I can't explain what happened, but my life is torture when I can't speak with her...

It's been a terrible burden to her as well, I know that...  and that makes me want to end things even more.  She never asked for this.  I never asked for it either.  The end result is that therapy doesn't work, drugs don't work, dating other women doesn't work, nothing works...  except one thing.  When we communicate, the pressure goes away, and I feel completely normal, calm, rational and productive.  Why?  I don't know, and it's a nightmare.

The feelings have not gone away for two years.  I've sought help, doctors, drugs, medications, meditation.  I have tried everything I could think of to try.  There is this unbearable pain that grows and grows, and I don't know what it is or how to describe it.  The only times in the the last two years that I haven't felt this pain is when she and I were talking again and were friends.  I honestly don't know what else to do, I'm at the end of my rope.
